niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, modern interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, clear grouping, prominent primary actions, and generous spacing. They consistently like screens that feel refined and branded rather than plain or utilitarian, with obvious section separation through cards, spacing, and contrast. They favor layouts that reduce clutter, keep attention on one main task, and make actions easy to spot. They also respond well to richer, more engaging content presentation when it improves clarity or appeal, such as vivid imagery, stronger card structure, and more intentional affordances.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers interfaces that look refined, cohesive, premium, modern, and intentionally branded rather than plain, rough, or utilitarian.
Prefers clear hierarchy with distinct section emphasis, readable structure, separated content blocks, and obvious prioritization of major elements.
Prefers CTAs and main actions that are visually dominant, easy to find, and clearly prioritized through size, contrast, placement, or stronger styling.
Prefers content organized into separate cards, grouped sections, or contained modules rather than flat layouts where elements blend together.
Prefers cleaner screens with fewer competing elements, less distracting chrome, and stronger focus on one primary task or content area.
Prefers text, labels, and content presentation that are easy to read and scan, with stronger contrast, clearer wording, and more visible content structure.
Prefers layouts with more whitespace, padding, and visual breathing room so content feels lighter and easier to scan.
